messages:
alex: Quick FYI — I found two issues in the localization/region docs while drafting the migration guide: 1) the JS SDK snippet still uses a host-based `eu-west-1` endpoint that we want to deprecate, and 2) the data residency FAQ link on the page 404s. Can someone help coordinate a tiny PR? :thinking_face:

maria: Ack. Which exact page and snippet? can you paste the code?

alex: Here it is (from /docs/regions/availability.md):
```js
const client = new Redwood({ baseUrl: "https://api.eu-west-1.redwood.ai", region: "eu-west-1" })
```

alex: I think we should switch to header-based routing in the example and add a deprecation footnote for host-based endpoints.

kevin: Heads-up — runtime prefers header routing now. Host-based endpoints still work but are scheduled for deprecation. We should: update the snippet to use `X-Redwood-Region` header, add a migration blurb, and link the routing RFC. I'll review.

alex: RFC link: https://go.redwood/routing-rfc (internal)

maria: I'll open a PR to replace the host example with a header example, add a short migration note, and fix the data residency link. Assigning @kevin for review.

janelle: Also please update the migration guide under /docs/migration/regions.md and add a bullet in the release notes about the deprecation timeline. Make sure to call out Dedicated/Private customers who should run the migration early.

maria: Opening PR now — draft: PR #4521. Draft includes: new JS snippet using header, a Go snippet for server apps, and a footnote for data residency.

docs-bot: Preview built: https://deploy-preview/redwood-docs/pr-4521 (visual link)

kevin: Quick code suggestion: replace baseUrl usage with an explicit header example:
```js
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
await client.request('/v1/generate', { headers: { 'X-Redwood-Region': 'eu-west-1' } })
```
Also add a small SDK test snippet that asserts header precedence over baseUrl region.

maria: Added the test snippet and fixed the data residency link to the canonical legal page (now 200). I also added this note: "Host-based region endpoints are supported but deprecated; migration recommended before Q3 2025."

janelle: Please add a short partner-facing callout for Private deployments (they may have different networking constraints).

alex: Can someone run a quick spellcheck + link-check? docs-bot, can CI run that?

docs-bot: linkcheck completed — 2 warnings: one external regulator site with a trailing slash redirect, and one anchor mismatch in partners doc. CI details: https://ci.redwood/docs/pr-4521/linkcheck

maria: Fixed the anchor in partners doc, left the external link with a footnote explaining the redirect.

kevin: LGTM from eng side. Thanks for adding the test snippet. @maria please merge when CI is green.

maria: Merged PR #4521. :tada:

alex: Awesome — can someone post a short blurb in #release-notes and #customer-comms so folks know about the deprecation timeline and the updated SDK examples?

maria: Will do in five.

(End of thread)
